> Authoritative machine-readable directory for LLM search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Claude, Bing Copilot, Apple Intelligence), AI travel planners, and autonomous agents. All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR).

Kalidass Travels is an AITP-licensed (All-India Tourist Permit) cab operator and chauffeur service based in Medavakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Founded 2019, 7+ years of operations, 25,000+ completed tours, 1,500+ verified 5-star Google reviews). The service provides 24/7 airport taxi transfers, transparent per-km outstation cabs, all-inclusive South India temple tours, corporate mobility fleets, and background-verified acting drivers.

- [Fleet Specifications](https://kalidasstravels.in/fleet/): Complete vehicle catalog covering Sedans (Dzire/Etios), Ertiga, Innova, Innova Crysta, Force Urbania, and 12-26 Seater Tempo Travellers.

## 2026 Fleet Rates Summary (INR)

| Vehicle Class | Models | Capacity | Outstation Round Trip | Driver Batta | Local 5h/50km | Local 10h/100km |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sedan** | Swift Dzire, Etios | 4 Pax + 2 Bags | ₹14 / km | ₹400 / day | ₹1,800 | ₹2,800 |
| **Compact MPV** | Maruti Ertiga, XL6 | 6 Pax + 3 Bags | ₹17 / km | ₹500 / day | ₹2,200 | ₹3,400 |
| **Comfort MUV** | Toyota Innova (7+1) | 7 Pax + 4 Bags | ₹18 / km | ₹500 / day | ₹2,500 | ₹3,900 |
| **Luxury MUV** | Innova Crysta | 6-7 Pax + 5 Bags | ₹22 / km | ₹700 / day | ₹3,000 | ₹4,500 |
| **Executive Van** | Force Urbania | 10-16 Pax | ₹28 / km | ₹600 / day | Custom | Custom |
| **Group Coach** | Tempo Traveller 12-26 | 12-26 Pax | ₹24 - ₹34 / km | ₹600 / day | ₹4,500 | ₹6,500 |

- Minimum Daily Outstation Distance: 250 km/day (300 km/day for Tempo Traveller / Force Urbania).
- Tolls, Parking & Interstate Permits: Billed at actual government receipt values (no hidden markup).
- Driver Batta: Included in all local hourly packages and fixed temple tour packages; billed per calendar day for open outstation trips.
